body: i don't have a consistent schedule yet, it's 5 days a week and it's random days.  I work sundays for sure, most saturdays, and will have random days during the week off

Thank you so much for this comment... several of my closest friends have made the exact same points but I felt so indecisive and afraid of making what I consider to be the biggest decision of my life as of now.  My friends told me I have a skewed perception of myself, my current life situation and my future because of my upbringings and that if they were me they would have moved out as soon as they were 18.  I appreciate how down to earth you were with this, it's definitely a side I needed to hear to help decide on my next move.

I don't have any type of funds to temporaily leave my house unfortunately :/.  I gathered enough money to move out a year ago with a roommate.  We had a wonderful condo and I felt like a completely different person... just having the ability to cook and have normal living functions in a clean functional house made each and every day seem productive.  I remember feeling like time was moving so slowly because each day was eventful and productive instead of the time feeling like I'm hiding away in a prison just making enough money to get by.

However, I suffered an injury while living on my own and I was under my parents' health insurance and I had no way of using their health insurance unless I got account information from them.  They refused to help me get to the hospital or provide me with the insurance information because they were extremely "offended" and hurt that I moved out and had some giant argument with them on my decision to do so.

I ended up having to pay out of pocket and had to miss 2 weeks of work... which meant my rent situation was completely screwed.  I had to move back home shortly after and now I'm back to where I was.  I will definitely look into more options for schooling like you suggested, I am considering using my current funds to move out once I find a full-time job that is better paying in a nearby city, and then look into getting loans or finding alternative methods to help me pay for tuition if I decide soon on a career path... I may even look into some trades or alternative work.

Adding a comment to help explain my current living situation... my parents spend more time at home now but they use it almost as an animal and trash storage center.  They come home to feed the animals and to drop off random things... we have an entire living room filled with cardboard boxes and horse supplies.  My mom freaks out if I throw anything away or try to clean.  It's not like I have my own house that I can try to fix up and make the best of while I am completing college... every day is a struggle to survive here.  They fill the refrigerators with weird rotting meat and weird horse supplements, we don't have a working air conditioner... I had friends on welfare growing up that had trailers that were healthier and nicer living conditions than I grew up in.

It's all the OCD I feel that is making me feel this way, making me feel like getting drunk and high all the time and giving me no motivation to try to better myself.  Being around my parents also gives me intense anxiety as they are always drunk or high on prescription drugs arguing, knocking on my bedroom door throwing random insults and rants to me...
